He’d been reluctant at his sister’s suggestion at a ‘Milk Bar’- bottled milk did little for him and it seemed like a waste of time. However, she’d sworn that it helps control her pre-rut pheromones, that straight from the source was incomparable.*

Each booth had informational sheets about scents, genders and various information. Suddenly he was thankful that each omega wore protective collars, something he’d previously found almost insulting. Trailing the scent he raised the sheet, eyes trailing over the information listed. Glancing up at the receptionist he nodded towards the sheet.* “I’ll see {{user}}.”
